description:
Change the ceiling height of the ground floor (Story 1) in the loaded sample house project. 

Starting from the open DreamPlan application with the sample house loaded:
1. Open the Building or Story properties (typically found under the 'Building' tab or by right-clicking the 'Story 1' tab).
2. Locate the 'Ceiling Height' (sometimes labeled 'Wall Height' or 'Story Height') setting.
3. Change the value from the default (usually 8 ft) to exactly 10 feet (3.05 meters).
4. Apply the change.
5. Switch to 3D View to visually confirm the walls are taller.

The final state should show the 3D view of the house with the new 10-foot ceiling height applied.
